name: secret_egress_deny_userinfo_with_port_escape
description: Host-boundary escape, measured 2026-11-09: https://api.openai.com:443@evil.example/ used to satisfy the carve-out because the terminator accepted a colon, while the same URL without :443 was denied. The real host is evil.example. The carve-out now requires the listed name to be the whole authority, optionally followed by :port and then /, ?, # or end.
